description_en: Adds a shard node or a mongos node to an ApsaraDB for MongoDB sharded cluster instance
description_zh: 为云数据库MongoDB分片集群实例添加Shard节点或Mongos节点
kebab_example: aliyun dds create-node --db-instance-id dds-bp11501cd7b50000 --node-class dds.shard.mid --node-type shard --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateNode

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of the sharded cluster instance
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the shard node or mongos node. For more information about instance types, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/311414.html
parameters.help_zh: Shard节点或Mongos节点的规格，规格详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/311414.html
parameters.name: node_class

parameters.help_en:
The disk space of the node. Unit: GB.

The valid values vary based on the storage type. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/311414.html.

This parameter is required when the node type is shard
parameters.help_zh:
Node的磁盘空间，单位：GB。

不同存储类型支持的取值范围不同，具体信息，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/311414.html。

当节点类型为Shard时，需要配置该参数
parameters.name: node_storage

parameters.help_en:
The node type. Valid values:
shard: shard node.
mongos: mongos node
parameters.help_zh:
节点类型，取值说明：
shard：Shard节点。
mongos：Mongos节点
parameters.name: node_type

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests. The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:
true: enables automatic payment. This is the default value. Make sure that your account has sufficient balance.
<props="china">- false: disables automatic payment. You can log on to the ApsaraDB for MongoDB console, choose Billing > Expenses and Costs in the upper-right corner, choose Subscription Orders > My Orders in the left-side navigation pane, and then pay for the order on the Orders tab.</props>
<props="intl">- false: disables automatic payment. You can log on to the ApsaraDB for MongoDB console, choose Billing > Expenses and Costs in the upper-right corner, click Order Management in the left-side navigation pane, and then pay for the order on the Orders page.</props>

This parameter is required when the billing method is subscription
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动付费，取值说明：
true：（默认值）自动付费，请确保账号有足够的余额。
<props="china">- false：控制台手动付费。您可以登录云数据库MongoDB控制台，在页面右上角选择费用 > 费用与成本，在左侧导航栏，选择订购订单>我的订单，在商品订单页签找到目标订单进行支付。</props>
<props="intl">- false：控制台手动付费。您可以登录云数据库MongoDB控制台，在页面右上角选择费用 > 费用与成本，在左侧导航栏，单击订单管理，在商品订单页面找到目标订单进行支付。</props>

当付费类型为包年包月时，需要配置该参数
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
The number of read-only nodes in the shard node.

Valid values: 0 to 5. Default value: 0.
This parameter is supported only on the China site
parameters.help_zh:
设置Shard节点中只读节点的个数。

取值范围：0~5（整数），默认值为0。
当前仅中国站支持本参数
parameters.name: readonly_replicas

parameters.help_en: The additional parameter for business information
parameters.name: business_info

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to use a coupon. Valid values:
default or null: uses a coupon. This is the default value.
youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank: does not use a coupon
parameters.help_zh:
是否使用优惠券，取值说明：
default或null（默认）：使用优惠券。
youhuiquan_promotion_option_id_for_blank：不使用优惠券
parameters.name: coupon_no

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to apply for a direct connection endpoint for the shard node. Valid values:

true: applies for a direct connection endpoint for the shard node.
false: does not apply for a direct connection endpoint for the shard node. This is the default value
parameters.help_zh:
是否申请Shard节点直连地址，取值说明：

true：申请Shard节点直连地址。
false：（默认值）不申请Shard节点直连地址
parameters.name: shard_direct

parameters.help_en:
The username. Valid values:

The username must start with a lowercase letter.
The username can contain lowercase letters, digits, and underscores (_).
The username must be 4 to 16 characters in length.

ApsaraDB for MongoDB does not support keywords as usernames.
The permissions of the account are fixed to read-only.
When you apply for a direct connection endpoint for the shard node for the first time, you must set the username and password. You do not need to set them again for subsequent applications
parameters.help_zh:
账号名，取值说明：

以小写字母开头。
由小写字母、数字或下划线（_）组成。
长度为4~16个字符。

云数据库MongoDB不支持使用关键字作为账号。
账号的权限固定为只读权限。
首次申请Shard节点直连地址时，需要设置账号和密码，后续申请无需再次设置
parameters.name: account_name

parameters.help_en:
The password of the account. Valid values:
The password must contain at least three of the following character types: uppercase letters, lowercase letters, digits, and special characters.
Special characters include !@#$%^&*()_+-=.
The password must be 8 to 32 characters in length.

ApsaraDB for MongoDB does not support resetting the password of the account for the shard node
parameters.help_zh:
账号密码，取值说明：
由大写字母、小写字母、数字、特殊字符中的至少三种组成。
!@#$%^&*()_+-=为特殊字符。
长度为8~32个字符。

云数据库MongoDB不支持重置Shard节点的账号密码
parameters.name: account_password

parameters.help_en: The instance type of the search node to be added
parameters.help_zh: 待添加的 Search 节点实例规格
parameters.name: search_db_instance_class

parameters.help_en: The storage capacity of the search node to be added
parameters.help_zh: 待添加的 Search 节点存储容量
parameters.name: search_storage

parameters.help_en: The number of search nodes to be added
parameters.help_zh: 待添加的 Search 节点数量
parameters.name: search_node_count
